invariants.rule: Cellerator owns reusable mathematical/dynamical computation; Baseplane owns sequence meaning and representations; GlassHelix owns scientific experiments. Reuse existing numerical/lifetime owners, preserve real consumers and separate Todo authorities.

Execute only after the reviewed predecessor barrier. Preserve useful mechanisms, source, successful outcomes and negative evidence. No hand editing Todo/generated authority, no Ampere activation, no preprint edits, no CellShard authority changes.

Keep the libraries easy to extend and fast. No compulsory Cellpack format, universal hidden axis, second general runtime, or unmeasured default. Distinguish equivalent lowering, model choices and approximations.
